definitions.gloss: to pay in; to pay (a fee) into an account
definitions.explanation: To pay money into a designated account or to an organization, typically fees, premiums, taxes or subscriptions, at a bank, post office or convenience store. The noun {払|はら}い{込|こ}み is common on forms and slips.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会費|かいひ}→会費：08469_kaihi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{払|はら}い{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I paid in the membership fee.

examples.japanese: ⟦{授業料|じゅぎょうりょう}→授業料：14967_jugyouryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{払|はら}い{込|こ}んで⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please pay the tuition at a bank.

examples.japanese: ⟦{申込書|もうしこみしょ}→申込書：03162_moushikomisho⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦{用紙|ようし}→用紙：09588_youshi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{保険料|ほけんりょう}→保険料：11058_hokenryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{払|はら}い{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I paid the insurance premium at a convenience store with the slip that came with the application form.

notes:
Made of ⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧ (to pay) + ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (into). Mostly written and administrative.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: transitive (money ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ {払|はら}い{込|こ}む; recipient account or organization ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧ / ⟦{会費|かいひ}→会費：08469_kaihi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{払|はら}い{込|こ}む: to pay in a fee
- ⟦{口座|こうざ}→口座：05419_kouza⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{払|はら}い{込|こ}む: to pay into an account
- {払込用紙|はらいこみようし}: payment slip
- {払込期限|はらいこみきげん}: payment deadline

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{振|ふ}り{込|こ}む→振り込む：10992_furikomu⟧: to transfer money to an account; the usual word for a bank transfer, while {払|はら}い{込|こ}む stresses paying what is owed
- ⟦{納|おさ}める→納める：02280_osameru⟧: to pay (tax, fees) to an authority; more formal
